gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Tube-bent letters, loud and glowing. Noto Sans Tagbanwa follows in a plain sans with open curves and tall lowercase, a quieter partner for Tilt Neon's wire-like heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet reads approachable, with a tall middle band and terminals pulled back from the curves. Tilt Neon is the showman here, every curve drawn without stress, while the plain sans does the steady talking.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks gently magnified, terminals stopping far from the stem. Over many lines that spaciousness keeps the sans easy going, while Tilt Neon's wire-bent s curves never thin at the spine.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: Stocky, round and loud up top. Tilt Neon draws like a technical pen, while Noto Sans Tamil Supplement offers sans-serif forms like open parentheses inside a very tall middle band.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Neutral is the mood of Noto Sans Telugu, with a high-set midline and counters joined to the outside. Tilt Neon sits above it with no hairlines anywhere, and the sans text runs smoothly beneath that bold tube of a heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai reads approachable, its lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads and its rounded letters left open. Tilt Neon matches that friendliness with curves that meet the stems exactly, bold and commanding.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: Noto Sans Thai Looped has spacious gaps at its curve terminals and a tall body that looks bold. Noto Sans Thai Looped keeps that plain sans weight going line after line, while Tilt Neon's turns never thin.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh keeps its rounded letters open and inviting, with bowls that fill the line like inflated shapes. Tilt Neon's o has a constant wall.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Tilt Neon feels like tracing a single thick thread, with a splayed c terminal and short ascenders. Noto Sans Tirhuta sits beside it with a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave a big gap.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Approachable and clean, this pairing hums. Tilt Neon holds steady pen pressure from first letter to last, while Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps a tiny gap between x-height and cap height, with mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs.
